stem: With which statement would the poet and the author of the selection most likely agree?

options.label: A
options.text: It is important to ask for help when building a sandcastle.

options.label: B
options.text: The details of a sandcastle should be carved by hand.

options.label: C
options.text: Children like building sandcastles more than adults do.

options.label: D
options.text: A well-made sandcastle takes time to build.
